purpose: Separate public Framework distribution from independently selectable, chat-loadable Factory and Operating Model JSON packages with per-package access and immutable compatibility binding.

HUMAN_LOADED_PACKAGE.rule: Loaded package content must validate and paid content additionally requires independently verified entitlement evidence.

ENTITLED_PACKAGE_SOURCE.rule: Resolve only after entitlement verification; package bytes remain separate from public Framework distribution.

PROJECT_PINNED_SNAPSHOT.rule: May reproduce an already approved project binding only; never expands package access.

paidPathRule: A PAID_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED selected package is never resolved from PUBLIC_CANONICAL_REPOSITORY; its model content is never embedded in the public Framework bundle and it must carry separately verifiable entitlement evidence before use.
selectionRule: Resolve creation-profile defaults, apply HUMAN-approved overrides, then enforce the profile selectedPackageAccessPolicy before package access. WEBSITE allows compatible free/paid composition; SOFTWARE_SAAS and BOOK require both selected packages to be paid and independently entitled.
mixedAccessRule: Mixed FREE_PUBLIC and PAID_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED packages are permitted only when the active creation profile allows ANY_COMPATIBLE_ACCESS. Profiles marked BOTH_PAID_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED reject any free selected member.
